card.name: Final pieces of rare drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a few specific drug names, such as the 'line' in pargyline, the 'ine' in metyrosine, the 'one' in nitisinone and the 'y' in phenylbutyrate. It fires when the name is split into parts and this piece completes it.
